phases.name: Foundation
phases.focus: Establish safe movement patterns and aerobic base

phases.name: Progression
phases.focus: Gradually increase volume and introduce new exercises

non_negotiables: Keep heart rate under 70% age-predicted max (~115 bpm)

stage2.text:
PLAN "Post-MI General Fitness 12-Week Programme"
TYPE workout
VISIBILITY public
GOALS
  GOAL primary general_fitness:
    name "General Fitness and Cardiovascular Health"
PHASES
  PHASE "Foundation" (4 weeks):
    WEEK 1:
      DAY Monday training 50m "Full Body Strength":
        warmup:
          treadmill 5m
        main straight_sets:
          leg_press 2x12 rpe 5 rest 90 seconds
          chest_fly 2x12 rpe 5 rest 90 seconds
          seated_row 2x12 rpe 5 rest 90 seconds
          shoulder_press 2x10 rpe 5 rest 90 seconds
          calf_raise 2x15 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
          plank 2x20 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          hamstring_stretch 3m
      DAY Wednesday training 40m "Cardio & Mobility":
        warmup:
          treadmill 5m
        main straight_sets:
          cycling 15m rpe 5 rest 0 seconds
          walking 10m rpe 4 rest 0 seconds
        cooldown:
          chest_stretch 2m
          cat_cow 2m
      DAY Friday training 50m "Full Body Strength":
        warmup:
          elliptical 5m
        main straight_sets:
          goblet_squat 2x12 rpe 5 rest 90 seconds
          lat_pulldown 2x12 rpe 5 rest 90 seconds
          dumbbell_press 2x10 rpe 5 rest 90 seconds
          leg_extension 2x12 rpe 5 rest 90 seconds
          seated_calf_raise 2x15 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
          bird_dog 2x10 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
